name: Wealthfolio
short_desc: Private investment, net worth and portfolio tracker
author: Wealthfolio
description: Wealthfolio is a privacy-first, open-source portfolio tracker. It consolidates holdings from several brokers and banks into one dashboard and tracks performance, net worth, dividends, income and allocations, benchmarked against indexes such as the S&P 500. Everything lives in a local SQLite database — no account, no cloud sync. This is the self-hosted web edition of the desktop app.

form_fields.label: App URL
form_fields.hint: Exact origin you open Wealthfolio with — scheme, host and port, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8088 or https://wealthfolio.example.com. Used as the allowed CORS origin; a mismatch blocks every API call.

form_fields.label: Password hash (argon2id)
form_fields.hint: Argon2id PHC hash of your login password, generated with: printf '%s' 'your-password' | argon2 yoursalt16chars -id -e . If the login fails because the hash contains $ signs, write the hash into app-data/data/password.hash instead — that file wins over this field. See the app description.

form_fields.label: Secret key
form_fields.hint: Encrypts stored API keys and broker credentials and signs session tokens. Back it up together with app-data — the database is useless without it.

form_fields.label: Require login
form_fields.hint: Leave enabled. Turn it off only when a reverse proxy in front of the app already authenticates every request — otherwise your portfolio is readable by anyone who can reach the port.
